children: Insurance software provider's Q4 revenue rose 15%, beating analyst expectations
Adjusted EPS and adjusted net income for Q4 beat analyst expectations
Company repurchased $606.3 mln in shares during fiscal 2026
Guidewire sees Q1 2027 total revenue between $372 mln and $378 mln
Company expects FY 2027 total revenue between $1,707 mln and $1,727 mln
Guidewire forecasts FY 2027 operating cash flow between $445 mln and $465 mln
SUBSCRIPTION GROWTH - Q4 subscription and support revenue rose 32%, which the company attributed to expanding demand for core and AI-focused products
LICENSE REVENUE DECLINE - License revenue fell 18% in Q4, with no specific explanation provided by the company
FOREIGN CURRENCY IMPACT - GAAP net income was negatively affected by a $24 mln foreign currency loss in Q4
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 14 "strong buy" or "buy", 2 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the software peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Guidewire Software, Inc. is $210.00, about 8.9% above its September 2 closing price of $192.76
The stock recently traded at 47 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 37 three months ago
